correctness.rationale: For all n>=1, compose direct-sum decreasing layers with composition parts. Their distinct minors exactly decrement a positive nonunit or erase unit. Binary terminal-one encoding and the established alternating-interval theorem give a necessary and sufficient boundary filter; the resulting precisely two unique local move families yield the edge rational function. All nonheavy gaps preserve weight and 2-presence; swapping 1,2 and replacing 121 with 22 gives a terminating canonical representative, proving Fibonacci product components and both rational count series. Explicit separate direct-minor and bit-deletion programs passed for every n<=11. Infinite theorem rests on proof, not finite checks.

value.rationale: The 2-read common-minor graph measures which restricted permutation sources can share two distinguishable one-deletion observations. It has exponentially many inputs, yet exact component signatures, Fibonacci-product sizes, all-length connected-component and isolation enumerators. This determines the global communication ambiguity decomposition, not a routine special case or isolated finite count. It does not claim maximum independent sets or optimal codebook sizes.
